sensors.title: Choose measurements

data_description.consumption_sensor: W or kW. Often called Consumption: sensor.izypower_cloud_station_name_consommation. Exclude battery charging.
data_description.grid_sensor: Often Grid power: sensor.izypower_cloud_station_name_puissance_reseau. Positive = import, negative = export. With separate meters, select positive import here.
data_description.additional_consumption: Leave empty if the main sensor already includes all loads. An EV charger is optional. Example: sensor.izypower_cloud_station_name_puissance_borne_de_recharge. Never add a load twice.
data_description.export_sensor: Only for two distinct positive import/export sensors, e.g. sensor.grid_export_power. Leave empty for a signed grid sensor.
data_description.source_timestamp: Example: sensor.izypower_cloud_station_name_derniere_mise_a_jour. Deduplicates cloud reports. Otherwise HA states are sampled.
data_description.currency: Three-letter code such as EUR, CHF or CAD. It remains fixed for this history.
data_description.invert_grid: Enable only for a grid sensor that is negative on import and positive on export.
data_description.max_age_seconds: Seconds; 0 disables age checks for sources that only publish on value changes.
data_description.max_gap_seconds: Seconds; longer gaps are skipped without discarding the rest of the day.

sensors.description: Select consumption and grid power. All other measurements are optional; an EV charger is not required.

tariffs.title: Configure import tariffs

data_description.base_rate: Price per kWh. For a single rate, leave both period options disabled. Zero is allowed.
data_description.off_peak_enabled: Optional; disable to use only the base rate.
data_description.off_peak_rate: Price per kWh when off-peak is enabled.
data_description.off_peak_windows: Daily ranges: 22:00-06:00,13:00-15:00. Overnight windows are supported.
data_description.super_off_peak_enabled: Optional; takes precedence over overlapping off-peak windows.
data_description.super_off_peak_windows: For example 02:00-04:00. Separate multiple windows with commas.

tariffs.description: Prices are per kWh. New prices and schedules are recorded and do not reprice past periods.

export.title: Configure export

data_description.export_mode: Unpaid export is distinct from selling. Export energy is always recorded; only remunerated export earns revenue. Does not control hardware.
data_description.export_rate: Price per exported kWh, independent of import. Ignored when export is not remunerated.

export.description: Unpaid export is separate from selling. These options do not control hardware.
